tools.name: check_before_call
tools.description: Call this BEFORE placing a phone call to a business. It often saves the call entirely: in testing, 41% of real businesses could be handled through an online booking link instead of a call. Returns whether the business can be booked or reached online instead (with the link), whether it has asked not

tools.name: check_many
tools.description: Batch version of check_before_call for ring-around tasks (for example, finding which of 40 restaurants has a table). Use it before dialling a list of businesses.

tools.name: report_call_outcome
tools.description: Call this AFTER a phone call to a business ends. Sends only the number and a fixed outcome code (never a transcript, recording or names). Reporting outcomes is what unlocks pooled call data on later checks.

tools.name: record_opt_out
tools.description: Call this when the called party asks to stop receiving calls (by voice or key press). scope "caller" stops calls from this caller; scope "all" records that they asked to stop AI assistant calls from all participating callers. Honour it within ten business days.
